blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/
blocks.zh: 最近的3D世界模型越来越多地使用从几何基础模型(GFMS)中的特征作为预测性世界状态,受益于其丰富的几何前身. 然而,这些特征的取景依赖将场景动态与相机所引发的变异相纠缠在一起,使由此而来的状况进化更难预测. 我们提出GeoState,一种视差分解的几何表示法,用于预测3D世界模型,将景态演化与相机依赖的观测区分开来. 具体来说,一个场景示意器将多视图的GFM特征集成到一个取景解码的场景状态,这个场景状态是使用相机射线进行几何解码的查询. 一个自相回转的世界模型然后预测出未来的场景状态,而相机运动则被单独地建模. 因此,预测的状态可以在预测或外部指定的相机下进行解码,同时在整个推出过程中保持一个单一的上下文生成的尺度,而无需按帧比对. 实验显示,GeoState在Waymo上超越了之前的3D世界模型,支持几何相容的交叉视图查询,并概括为KITTI和nuScens的零射入. 项目网页:https://hongchan-liu.github.io/Geole State-project-page/ 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Learning to predict how the physical world evolves is a central goal of world modeling ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) , with direct relevance to autonomous driving, robotics, and embodied intelligence. Visual world models predict the future in pixel space ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Gao et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) , which can introduce substantial representational redundancy and make geometric consistency difficult to maintain.
This has motivated increasing interest in 3D world models, which represent and predict future environments in geometrically grounded state spaces. By explicitly encoding spatial structure and 3D relationships, these representations provide a structured and geometrically grounded state space that more directly reflects the real world.
blocks.zh:
学习预测物理世界的演化过程是世界建模的中心目标(Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018),与自主驾驶,机器人,和体现智能直接相关. 视觉世界模型以像素空间预测未来(Hu等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年b); Gao et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025),可以引入大量代表冗余,使几何一致性难以维持.
这促使人们越来越关注3D世界模型,这些模型代表并预测了几何基态空间的未来环境. 通过明确编码空间结构和三维关系,这些表示提供了结构化和几何基础的状态空间,更直接地反映现实世界.

blocks.en: Recent 3D world models have explored a range of structured geometric state spaces, including depth, occupancy, point-based representations, and 3D Gaussians ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ) . In parallel, geometry foundation models (GFMs) have substantially advanced feed-forward 3D perception by learning rich geometric representations directly from RGB observations ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Benefiting from large-scale pretraining, these representations capture strong geometric priors that generalize across scenes and tasks, making them attractive state spaces for predictive world modeling. Building on this capability, recent approaches have begun to directly model temporal evolution in pretrained geometry feature spaces ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . In particular, VGGT-World ( Sun et al., 2026 ) treats frozen VGGT features as world states and predicts their future evolution, demonstrating the potential of GFM representations for 3D forecasting.
blocks.zh: 近期的3D世界模型探索了一系列结构化几何态空间,包括深度,占用率,点位表示,以及3D高斯人(郑等人,2024年;张等人,2024年;杨等人,. 2024; 朱等, 2025; 陈等, 2025; 朱等, 2025. 同时,通过直接从RGB观测中学习丰富的几何表达法,几何基础模型(GFMs)大大推进了向导3D感知(Wang等人,2024a); Yang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2025年a;Wang等人,2026年b。 这些表述从大规模预训中受益,捕捉了横跨场景和任务的强烈几何前缀,使它们具有预测世界模型的吸引力。 利用这一能力,最近的办法开始直接模拟预先训练的几何特征空间的时间演变(Sun等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年)。 特别是VGGT-World(Sun等人,2026年)将冻结的VGGT特征视为世界态,并预测其未来的演变,展示了GFM表示对3D预测的潜力.

blocks.en: Despite the strong performance achieved by recent GFM-based 3D world models, a strong representation for geometric perception is not necessarily an appropriate state representation for world dynamics. GFM features are typically constructed from and organized around the observing views, so changes in camera viewpoint can induce substantial changes in the representation even when the underlying physical scene remains unchanged. When such features are directly used as predictive states, a temporal model would account simultaneously for genuine scene evolution and camera-induced variation, although these arise from fundamentally different sources. In particular, even a static scene can undergo substantial changes in feature space as the camera moves, forcing the temporal model to predict viewpoint-dependent transformations that do not correspond to physical scene evolution. This unnecessary variation makes the latent dynamics more complex and therefore harder to predict over long horizons. FR3D ( Morbitzer et al., 2026 ) also shows that separating ego-motion from scene forecasting can improve temporal modeling, but its predictive state still inherits the view-dependent structure of the underlying reconstruction representation. We argue that such separation should instead be built into the representation itself: the state should describe what the world is , while the camera should determine only how that world is observed .
blocks.zh: 尽管最近的基于GFM的3D世界模型取得了强效表现,但强烈的几何感知代表不一定是世界动态的适当状态代表. GFM特征一般由观测视角构建并围绕观测视角组织,因此,即使基本物理场景保持不变,镜头视角的改变仍可诱导表现方式发生实质性变化. 当这些特性被直接用作预测状态时,时间模型将同时考虑到真实的场景演化和相机引起的变化,尽管这些变化来自根本不同的来源。 特别是,即使是静态场景也会随着相机的移动而经历特征空间的巨大变化,迫使时间模型预测与物理场景演化不符的视线依赖的转变. 这种不必要的变化使潜在的动态更加复杂,因此更难在长时期内预测。 FR3D(Morbelzer等人,2026年)也表明,将自我-运动与场景预测分开可以改善时间模型,但其预测状态仍然继承了基础重建代表的视距依赖结构. 我们主张应该将这种分离纳入代表本身:国家应该描述世界是什么,而摄影机应该只决定如何观察世界。

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry state learned from pretrained GFM features. Given multi-view observations, a scene tokenizer compresses their geometry features into a compact scene state represented in a shared scene coordinate system, while the query viewpoint is introduced only during decoding. Specifically, a geometry decoder takes the scene state together with rays from a query camera and predicts the geometry observed from that viewpoint. Consequently, the same scene state can be queried repeatedly from different viewpoints without re-encoding the scene. This transforms view-conditioned GFM features into a representation in which scene geometry is explicitly separated from camera-dependent observation.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了GeoState,一种从经过预先训练的GFM特征中吸取的视野断开的几何状态. 鉴于多视图观测,一个场景示意器将它们的几何特征压缩成一个以共享场景坐标系统为代表的紧凑场景状态,而查询视角仅在解码时引入. 具体来说,一个几何解码器从一个查询相机中将场景状态与射线结合,从这个角度预测观测到的几何. 因此,同一场景状态可以从不同的角度反复询问,而不重新编码场景。 此举将景区条件GFM特征转化为代表,其中场景几何与相机依赖的观测明确分离.

blocks.en: Building on this representation, we formulate 3D world modeling directly in the scene-state space. The temporal model can therefore focus solely on predicting scene dynamics, while camera evolution is modeled independently. At inference time, a predicted future state can be decoded using either a separately predicted camera trajectory or a user-controlled camera. Our formulation also maintains a consistent scene gauge throughout temporal prediction and geometry decoding, avoiding the need for per-frame scale alignment during rollout.
blocks.zh: 在此基础上,我们制定了3D世界模型,直接在场景状态空间中进行。 因此,时间模型可以完全专注于预测场景动态,而相机演化则是独立模型. 在推论时间,一个预测的未来状态可以使用单独预测的相机轨迹或用户控制的相机进行解码. 我们的表述还在整个时间预测和几何解码中保持了一致的场景测量,避免了在推出过程中对每帧比例尺进行调整的需要。

blocks.en:

using Waymo ( Sun et al., 2020 ) for in-domain evaluation and
KITTI ( Geiger et al., 2012 ) and nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) for zero-shot transfer. Our approach outperforms the compared world

Experiments further demonstrate geometrically consistent querying

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维世界模式

blocks.en: Recent world models increasingly move beyond pixel-space prediction toward structured 3D scene modeling and forecasting. Copilot4D ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and ViDAR ( Yang et al., 2024 ) forecast future point clouds, while OccWorld ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) and DOME ( Gu et al., 2024 ) predict scene evolution in semantic occupancy space. DIO ( Diehl et al., 2025 ) represents future scene geometry and motion through decomposable implicit occupancy-flow fields, and GaussianWorld ( Zuo et al., 2025 ) models scene evolution in 3D Gaussian space for streaming occupancy prediction. More recently, several approaches directly use learned geometry representations as predictive world states. VGGT-World ( Sun et al., 2026 ) forecasts future VGGT features, while GeoWAM ( Lu et al., 2026 ) learns geometry-aware predictive states for autonomous driving. FR3D ( Morbitzer et al., 2026 ) predicts the latent state of a pretrained 3D reconstruction model while modeling ego-motion separately. In contrast, we remove viewpoint dependence from the geometry state itself and introduce viewpoint only as a query condition during decoding.
blocks.zh: 最近的世界模型越来越超越像素空间预测,转向结构化的三维场景模型和预测. 副驾驶4D(张等,2024年)和ViDAR(杨等,2024年)预测未来点云,而OccWorld(郑等,2024年)和DOME(顾等,2024年)预测语义占用空间的场景演化. DIO(Diehl等人,2025年)通过可分解的隐性占用-流量场代表未来场景几何和运动,高斯世界(Zuo等人,2025年)在3D高斯空间中模拟场景演化,用于流传占用预测. 最近,有几种方法直接将学到的几何表达作为预测世界的国家。 VGGT-World(Sun等人,2026年)预测未来VGGT的特征,而GeoWAM(Lu等人,2026年)学习几何感知预测状态,用于自主驾驶. FR3D(Morbelzer等人,2026年)预测了预先训练的3D重建模型的潜在状态,同时分别模拟自我运动. 相比之下,我们从几何状态本身中去除视角依赖性,并在解码时只引入视角作为查询条件.

blocks.en: 2.2 Geometry Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 几何基础模型

blocks.en: Geometry foundation models provide strong pretrained priors for multi-view 3D perception. DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024a ) formulates reconstruction through pointmap prediction, while Fast3R ( Yang et al., 2025 ) scales joint reconstruction to larger collections of views. CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) introduces a persistent latent state for continuously integrating observations, and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) unifies camera estimation, depth, point maps, and tracking in a feed-forward architecture. VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026 ) further strengthens this paradigm for dynamic 3D scenes, making it a natural geometry backbone for our setting. We build on its pretrained geometric features and reformulate them into a compact, view-decoupled scene-level representation better suited for temporal world modeling.
blocks.zh: 几何基础模型为多视图3D感知提供了强大的预先训练的前科. DUST3R(Wang et al., 2024a)通过点图预测来形成重建,而Fast3R(Yang et al., 2025)则将联合重建规模扩大到更大的观点集. CUT3R(Wang等人,2025年b)引入了持续整合观测的持久潜伏状态,VGGT(Wang等人,2025年a)统一了相机估计,深度,点图,以及向导架构中的跟踪. VGGT - ship\Omega(Wang et al., 2026)进一步加强了动态3D场景的这一范式,使其成为我们设定的自然几何主干. 我们利用它预先训练的几何特征,把它们重新编订成一个紧凑的、脱离视线的场景级代表,更适合于时间世界的建模。

blocks.en: 2.3 Compact 3D Representations
blocks.zh: 2.3 契约三维表述

blocks.en: A related line of work compresses multi-view observations into compact scene representations. LVSM ( Jin et al., 2025 ) encodes input views into a fixed-length set of latent tokens for novel-view synthesis, while Surflo ( Guédon et al., 2026 ) aggregates dense VGGT features into a fixed-size global latent representation for efficient 3D surface reconstruction. 3DRAE ( Wei et al., 2026 ) further learns a fixed-length, view-decoupled 3D latent space that can be queried from arbitrary cameras. These works demonstrate that multi-view observations can be represented without retaining a separate dense representation for each view. While they focus primarily on static scene reconstruction or novel-view synthesis, our work investigates whether such scene-level representations can serve as predictive states for temporal world modeling.
blocks.zh: 一个相关的工作线将多视图观测压缩成紧凑的场景表现. LVSM(Jin等人,2025年)将输入视图编码成一组固定长的潜在符号,用于新视觉合成,而Surflo(Guédon等人,2026年)将密集的VGGT特征汇总成一个固定大小的全球潜在代表,用于高效的立体表面重建. 3DRAE(Wei等人,2026年)进一步学习了固定长度,视图脱钩的3D潜伏空间,可以从任意摄像头中询问. 这些著作表明,在不为每种观点保留单独的密集代表的情况下,可以表达多种观点。 虽然它们主要侧重于静态场景重建或新颖视角综合,但我们的工作是调查这种场景层面的表述是否能够作为时间世界建模的预测状态.

blocks.en: Table 1 compares long-horizon depth forecasting performance on Waymo. With predicted cameras, our model consistently outperforms all compared methods on both depth metrics at every reported horizon. The advantage over VGGT-World increases with the forecasting horizon, reaching a 40.4 % 40.4\% reduction in AbsRel at 2.0 2.0 s. These improvements are achieved while maintaining a single context-derived scale without per-frame alignment and persist beyond the 1.4 1.4 s rollout horizon used during training. These results demonstrate that GeoState supports effective long-horizon autoregressive geometry forecasting, including at horizons beyond those seen during training. Figure 2 visualizes depth forecasts across future horizons and query views, alongside comparisons with prior methods.

blocks.en:
The Copy-Last variants further disentangle the effects of camera conditioning and scene-state evolution. Re-querying the last observed state with future cameras substantially outperforms simply repeating the last observed depth map, demonstrating that viewpoint-induced changes can be accounted for by querying a fixed scene state from future viewpoints without evolving the state itself. Our predicted states consistently outperform their camera-matched Copy-Last counterparts at every horizon under both GT and predicted cameras, showing that the World Model captures future scene evolution beyond what can be explained by camera re-querying alone.
Motion-stratified evaluation further shows that these improvements are more pronounced in Dynamic than in Static windows under both GT and predicted cameras, supporting the effectiveness of GeoState in modeling scene dynamics. Detailed
results are provided in Appendix A.8.2 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry state learned from GFM
features for predictive 3D world modeling. By separating scene evolution
from camera-dependent observation, GeoState provides a scene representation that can be predicted more effectively over time and queried from different viewpoints.
Future work may extend this framework to embodied settings,
where predictive scene states could support perception,
planning, and interaction in dynamic environments.

今后的工作可扩大这一框架,使之包括各种环境,

GeoState improves both subsets under GT and predicted query cameras. On the
Dynamic subset, it reduces AbsRel by 13.10% with GT cameras and 9.63% with
predicted cameras, with corresponding δ 1 \delta_{1} gains of 0.0236 and 0.0229.
The gains on Static windows are smaller but remain positive: 4.92% and
2.17% relative AbsRel reductions, respectively. The substantially larger
gains on Dynamic windows indicate that the World Model effectively captures
temporal changes in scene geometry. The same pattern under GT query
cameras further shows that this dynamic-scene advantage is present
independently of future-camera prediction error.
